failure_slots: One int32 device flag for each distinct source_id, in ascending source_id order; host clears and reads all flags.
alias_policy: Incoming overwritten output cotangents, outgoing input cotangents, immutable seed snapshots and failure buffers are disjoint. Outside-mask seed slots stay unchanged.
reverse_reduction: weight reduced in ascending element order by one owner using an f64 accumulator; densities are differenced before multiplication to avoid cancellation.
admission: dimensions and index products must fit signed i32; all buffers contiguous, disjoint and sized to shapes; cell and topology indices valid; ntracers,nlev,ncells positive when used.

launch_abi.branch_record_status: Both entries re-execute the original helper predicates with uint32[13][2] counters. Floating-input probes and the two unreachable subtraction arms are recorded in the proof receipt.
launch_abi.failure_layout_status: int32 device slots per COMMON-AD section 35; host creates the ABI-v1 failure record.

polynomial_reason: Source line 117 is bilinear in active weight and density along a direction between unchanged helper branches; quadratic-floor proof uses the third difference and derivative-entry branch counters.
derivative_precision: The primal is f32. The tangent and adjoint decode f32 operands, including subnormals, to f64 for arithmetic and round each public f32 derivative result with the pinned IEEE helper; the shared weight cotangent has one deterministic f64 accumulator.
